name: Jabez
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Jabez was more honorable than his brethren, and his mother called his name Jabez because she bare him with sorrow, the meaning of the name matching the scripture itself.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 4: The Families of Judah and Simeon

points: Jabez called on the God of Israel and asked that He would bless him indeed, enlarge his coast, keep His hand with him, and keep him from evil, and the Most High granted him what he requested.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 4: The Families of Judah and Simeon
